column1: # The checks of shell/readwrite.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh. TerminalDxe prints a character
# outside ASCII as "?" unless the serial terminal is VT-UTF8 (edk2-stable202608
# ArmVirt's is not, so the checks of texts that cite "§" compare them with "?" in its place.
# DriverSample creates MyIfrNVData with its defaults; its "Serial port number", at 0xC0, has a
# READ that ends at the UNDEFINED among its CONDITIONAL operands, so get shows the stored value;
# its WRITE sets SerialPortStatus (0xC1), SerialPortIo (0xC2) and SerialPortIrq (0xC4) for the port
# "Read transformed" holds 0xEE at byte 7, which its READ gives plus 1
# byte 0 holds no option of the MAP of "Mapped choice", whose WRITE sets it

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | gsub("§"; "?")) == "<ValueUnavailable: its READ expression gives no value, and without a VarStore the question has no other (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.1)>"

column1: # "Read only" reads byte 1, "Linked value", whose WRITE copies it to byte 2 and, plus 0x100, to
# bytes 4 and 5; "Write only" keeps its value in byte 6 through its WRITE alone; the EFI_IFR_VALUE
# of "Computed value" gives "Linked value" plus 0x10, never its byte 8, 0x11
# set stores the value given, 100 at byte 7, which the READ of "Read transformed" then gives plus 1
# the UINT16 "Option width" holds 0xA507 at bytes 9 and 10, which no option has; set writes its
# UINT8 option "Narrow" zero-extended in both bytes, as edk2-stable202608
# a WRITE that sets AbsentBuffer, which has no variable, refuses set before any write

column3: . == {"error_message": "cannot set question \"Absent target\": its WRITE expression sets VarStore 0x0002 (EFI_IFR_VARSTORE \"AbsentBuffer\"), which set may not write: no EFI variable AbsentBuffer-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000201: the firmware has not created it, and set never creates variables"}

column1: # its EFI_IFR_VALUE makes "Computed value" read-only: set refuses it before any write

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "cannot set question \"Computed value\": its EFI_IFR_VALUE expression makes it read-only (UEFI 2.11 ?33.3.8.3.88)"

column1: # what each question without a VarStore lacks, or that its driver keeps its value, which this

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | gsub("§"; "?")) == "<ValueUnavailable: question has no VarStore; its driver keeps the value, which only EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL.CallBack() reaches (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.6), which uefisettings.efi does not call yet>"

(.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "cannot set question \"Driver held\": question has no VarStore; its driver keeps the value, which only EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL.CallBack() reaches (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.6), which uefisettings.efi does not call yet"

.responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | gsub("§"; "?")) == "<ValueUnavailable: question has no VarStore, READ or WRITE expression, or EFI_IFR_FLAG_CALLBACK, one of which UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.6 requires>"
(.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "cannot set question \"No value source\": question has no VarStore, READ or WRITE expression, or EFI_IFR_FLAG_CALLBACK, one of which UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.6 requires"

.responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | gsub("§"; "?")) == "<ValueUnavailable: question has no VarStore, READ expression or EFI_IFR_FLAG_CALLBACK, so it has no value to retrieve (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.1)>"
(.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "cannot set question \"Read only\": question has no VarStore, WRITE expression or EFI_IFR_FLAG_CALLBACK, so nothing keeps a changed value (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.1)"
.responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "<ValueUnavailable: its READ expression uses EFI_IFR_TO_UINT, which uefisettings does not evaluate>"

column1: # list-questions never calls a driver: it lists the question that its driver holds with get's

column3: any(.[]; .name == "Driver held" and (.answer | gsub("§"; "?")) == "<ValueUnavailable: question has no VarStore; its driver keeps the value, which only EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL.CallBack() reaches (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.6), which uefisettings.efi does not call yet>") and any(.[]; .name == "Read only" and .answer == "5") and any(.[]; .name == "Read transformed" and .answer == "101") and any(.[]; .name == "Computed value" and .answer == "21")
